description: Download current BillWatch deal data and filter by category, provider or plan. Returns US advertised base prices for streaming and VPN plans (listed prices, before taxes and extra fees). verified: true means the price was confirmed on the provider's official page within its freshness window. By default only current, verified plans are returned; set include_unverified to also see stale or discontinued plans. Results are sorted by listed monthly-equivalent price, cheapest first. BillWatch makes no recommendations.

category.description: Only return plans in this category.

include_unverified.description: Also include plans that are unverified or no longer sold. Default false.

max_monthly_usd.description: Only return plans whose listed monthly-equivalent price is at most this many USD.

plan_id.description: Return only the plan with this exact id, e.g. 'hulu-live-tv-only'.

provider.description: Only return plans whose provider name contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. 'NordVPN'.

name: search_deals
